msg: The specific colours mean nothing.The gnomes are in 2 sets, Yellow and Purple tall mushrooms and Green and Pink small mushrooms. You want to stick with the same gnome of the set until they get to 4 or below and then pick the other.When the gnome set switches try and find the gnome giving 5+ and stick with that gnome until they get 4 below.The mushroom amount on the same gnome doesn't seem to change more than 2 either way so, unless your unlucky, I don't think you will see less 2 mushrooms.
